rules-gear.note: Reviewed CDFW July 2026 finfish gear text: one line and at most two hooks with lingcod or rockfish aboard; salmon north of Point Conception has its own one-rod and barbless-hook rule.

rules-invertebrates.note: Reviewed current CDFW section 29.80 crab gear text: trap validation, deployment limit, marking, pre-opener prohibition and servicing requirements; season permission remains separate.

rules-whales.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026–27 Whale Safe Fisheries page: recreational Dungeness season currently closed; any future trap authorization requires the current zone decision.

rules-health.note: Reviewed CDFW health-closure page and dated September 2026 advisories; no listed Bodega target-specific closure was converted into a season opening or entrance clearance.

rules-ocean.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026 ocean index and official regional, in-season, health and species links; the index is a navigation source, not independent permission to fish.

rules-groundfish.note: Reviewed CDFW groundfish summary: San Francisco area all-depth Apr–Dec season, descending device and Cordell Bank all-groundfish prohibition; exact closure geometry remains separate.

rules-inseason.note: Reviewed CDFW in-season page through September 11: August San Francisco summer salmon closure did not change the September fall opening; May Fishing Zone 3 trap action requires new gear clearance.

rules-salmon.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026 fall salmon page: September 1–October 31 only from 38°02′ N to Pigeon Point, 20,000 Chinook guideline, two fish excluding coho and north-coast barbless gear.

rules-crab.note: Reviewed CDFW crab page and its links to the current invertebrate and whale-safe rules; it does not by itself confirm a future trap opening.

rules-book.note: Reviewed original 2026 CDFW ocean booklet sections and tables for California halibut, Dungeness, albacore, finfish possession and gear; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-proposals.note: Reviewed FGC 2026 rulemaking index: proposed recreational conformance action has pending adoption and no effective date, so it was not treated as operative law.

rules-tuna-federal.note: Reviewed current eCFR 50 CFR 660.721: 25 albacore north of Point Conception, 10 if trip enters southern EEZ, 24-hour/calendar-day and onboard restrictions.

rules-salmon-pdf.note: Reviewed original August 2026 CDFW salmon flyer: fall latitude band, 20-inch minimum, two-fish bag, no coho, single rod and barbless hook restrictions; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-groundfish-pdf.note: Reviewed original June 23 San Francisco groundfish table: Apr–Dec all depths, lingcod two at 22 inches, RCG ten with sublimits and four no-retention rockfish; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-pacific-halibut.note: Reviewed CDFW Pacific halibut page to distinguish it from California halibut; one-fish Pacific rule and south-of-Point-Arena quota season are not assigned to the California-halibut card.

rules-san-francisco.note: Reviewed September 1 CDFW outer-coast page: Point Arena–Pigeon Point jurisdiction, 38°02′ salmon line, California-halibut two at 22 inches and scheduled November 7 Dungeness opener.

mpa-point-reyes.note: Reviewed CDFW Point Reyes SMR, SMCA and Headlands Special Closure: no take in SMR, only salmon trolling or Dungeness trap in SMCA, and restricted Headlands entry.

rules-cordell.note: Reviewed CDFW groundfish summary statement prohibiting all groundfish fishing at Cordell Bank; the exact federal exclusion footprint remains a separate geometry gate.

conclusion: The six 2026 outer-coast profiles and Bodega–Point Reyes draft fishing rectangle were compared with the archived official source documents and CDFW's September 1 San Francisco management-area page. The entire draft rectangle lies between Point Arena and Pigeon Point; its northern portion remains outside the 38°02′ N salmon opening. Season windows remain conditional on fresh source checks, exact geography, MPAs, method and current advisories. This decision does not activate the draft package or certify fishing targets.
